title: All Windows Engagement Type To Active
description: Every playground window must have engagement.input. Typing anywhere in the app routes to the active window engagement command (puzzle 2d/3d/5d play).
summary:
Every playground window kind must expose engagement.input; printable keys and Escape route to the active window via document-level capture on Mode.

- framework/playground/core: enforceWindowKindsEngagementInput + test
- framework/playground/renderer/react: windowKindsToGolden enforces; enforcePuzzle3dPlayWindowEngagement skips undefined
- ui/react: Mode document keydown capture for engagement routing (canvas focus)
- puzzle/2d/play: engagement on all panes + bus commands + test
- puzzle/5d/play: engagement on 2d/3d windows + bus commands
- puzzle/3d/play: app runtime placeholder engagement

Tests: @semio-tech/ui-react 104, @semio-tech/framework-playground-core 8, @semio-tech/framework-playground-renderer-react 17, @semio-tech/puzzle-2d-play 11, @semio-tech/puzzle-5d-play 6.
